classification.difficultyReason: Each part finds a horizontal distance from an elevation angle, then resolves it along a bearing. In part b the student must also convert the reflex bearing 310° into a westward component. This is routine but multi-step and unscaffolded.

content.prompt: Answer each part to the nearest metre.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find how far north of $P$ the foot of the tower, $O$, is.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find how far west of $Q$ the foot of the tower, $O$, is.

answer.worked:
The bearing $310^\circ$ is $360^\circ-310^\circ=50^\circ$ west of north.
$$\begin{align*}\tan25^\circ&=\frac{45}{OQ}\\OQ&=\frac{45}{\tan25^\circ}\\\text{West distance}&=OQ\sin50^\circ\\&=\frac{45\sin50^\circ}{\tan25^\circ}\\&\approx74\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
